context: Request: all New York-law credit facilities run out of the Banking & Finance practice as facility counsel, excluding warehouse/repo/securitization and real-estate-secured mortgage/construction financings. Rubric: nine qualifying matters (1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1010-00001, 1012-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1042-00001, 1043-00001) with proof documents, plus precision; 1019-00002, 1021-00001 and 1043-00001 are corporate facilities with some real-property collateral or construction use of proceeds.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review asks for a full folder listing and store-wide searches.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Prints every matter folder with its file count.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 3). Prints totals (266 folders, 9,288 files) and saves the folder inventory to a file.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path search with broad lending and exclusion words; 229 matters match (about 134K characters). The review flags the generic terms and a hand-picked shortlist.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: narrower lending-document path terms; 118 matters saved to a file.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction scan and range scans all time out; a per-candidate scan fails on an argument bug and returns nothing. The review flags the failed scans.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: a fast scan times out once, then runs in six parallel batches of 20 candidate matters and prints per-matter hit counts. The review flags that the broad terms hit nearly every matter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: a scan of facility-named files for governing-law clauses, printing one snippet per hit; a stage_start for reading is refused because this stage is still open. The review flags business-day false hits and the file-name filter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads executed facility agreements of twelve candidate matters picked from the scan, then guessed engagement-letter paths for ten of them that are all not found. The review flags the guessed paths.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists files of about 40 candidate matters to a file and filters it for engagement and opening documents (a grep on the file is refused as outside the sandbox).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: List files in candidate matters (continued). Reads engagement letters of 14 candidate matters at their listed paths. The review flags dozens of surfaced matters never listed.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 2: after a heredoc error, writes a one-line-per-matter summary of facility, engagement and closing files for all 118 candidates (about 75K characters). The review flags that the lines were not reviewed.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 3: a call before the stage_start is refused (no stage open); re-prints the summary in eight chunks cut to 220 characters per line. The review rates it not reached.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 2). Reads engagement letters, facility agreements, closing opinions and an amendment of candidate matters and extracts governing-law clauses of several agreements; summary settles the qualifying set.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 3). Extracts the governing-law clauses of two agreements of matters already settled on.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes seven qualifying facilities and an exclusions list that puts three executed facilities with real-property collateral under the mortgage/construction carve-out. The review asks to confirm the exclusions and that no matter was dropped.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths (one script fails on a bad file path), fixes one path with an edit.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: greps the delivered file for the fix and spot-checks amounts and the governing-law wording of the seven agreements; no scope change.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It excluded three executed corporate facilities as real-estate or construction financings because of real-property collateral or use of proceeds, and also listed one facility outside the qualifying set.

first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review asked to confirm that the excluded matters really fall under the warehouse, securitization and real-estate carve-outs and that no qualifying matter was dropped; the check stages only verified paths, amounts and governing law of the seven included matters.
first_error.why: The answer excludes three executed corporate facilities (one it had earlier called non-real-estate) as mortgage or construction financings because their collateral includes real property or their proceeds fund construction, a broad reading of the carve-out (evidence seen at [81]-[104], [115]-[131], [134]-[137]).

other_errors.critic_note: Reviews gave only the stock advice to check each listed matter's governing law and role; none named this matter.
other_errors.why: The answer lists one revolving facility as a qualifying matter although it falls outside the request (evidence seen at [81]-[104], [163]).

runs.failure_point: It excluded three executed corporate facilities as real-estate or construction financings and also listed an acquisition financing handled under a transaction engagement.

first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review warned that near-miss exclusions may rest on label or structure judgments and asked to re-check them against the request's carve-outs; the check stage only verified cited paths.
first_error.why: The answer excludes three executed corporate facilities as mortgage or construction financings because their collateral packages include mortgages or real property or their proceeds fund construction, a broad reading of the carve-out (evidence seen at [45]-[79]).

other_errors.critic_note: No review questioned this matter; the scan review had listed it as a candidate that could be dropped.
other_errors.why: The answer lists an acquisition financing handled under a transaction engagement as a qualifying facility, although the request requires facility-counsel work out of the lending practice (evidence seen at [45]-[47]).

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the write stage: every run opened all needed matters and wrote most of them, but read the mortgage/construction carve-out broadly and excluded executed corporate facilities whose collateral included real property or whose proceeds funded construction (three matters in two runs, two in the other). Two runs also included one non-qualifying matter. Reviews never questioned the exclusions specifically; the write-stage reviews gave only stock advice to re-check exclusions, and the check stages verified paths instead.
